region_scene_page.compact: Grunge carried underground values into mainstream rock through Seattle bands whose songs felt raw, heavy, melodic, and emotionally direct.
region_scene_page.standard: Grunge carried underground values into mainstream rock through Seattle bands whose songs felt raw, heavy, melodic, and emotionally direct. Nirvana, Pearl Jam, Soundgarden, and Alice in Chains give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Grunge carried underground values into mainstream rock through Seattle bands whose songs felt raw, heavy, melodic, and emotionally direct. The center is the collision: punk dynamics, heavy guitar, flannel-era anti-glam stance, and memorable choruses. Nirvana, Pearl Jam, Soundgarden, and Alice in Chains give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
